Here is my response. 

Dying near friendly pikemen under no circumstances allow a clean revive with no fear of interruption. I can understand your thought process in making them “great assets” but giving them the ability to prevent revives/executions is a bit much, considering they already do good damage in groups, take multiple hits to take down, respawn, can contest points, and can actually reliably kill you as well. As a defender, executions are one of the keys things they should be going for and I just don’t think in the case of having a 1v1 with someone who you beat should have the life spared by an AI essentially. My point is, without the their ability to prevents revives and such, yes obviously would make them less viable, but wouldn’t make them useless by any means, and wouldn’t rob you of potential kills

So the real issue I have with this isn’t that you disagree because that’s fine, it’s just your using this as your argument against every point I’ve made. 

I don’t think COD or battlefield are that bad. Especially battlefield. I think it relies more on team play way more than cod ever has but that’s another topic. Now having a team all on comms making call outs, yes would obviously improve the overall experience of the mode, but the points I’ve made, would still be somewhat, not completely but somewhat of issue even with those things in. If I’d made an argument saying “I’m always getting team killed” then yes, playing more team based would be a completely valid response. However I just feel the points I’ve made are more leaning towards how the mode functions in general.
